checks.text: The page heading reads "Baby Activity Log" and, with no entries, the list area shows the text "No activities yet".

Selecting "Feeding" in the field labelled "Type", typing "120" in the field labelled "Duration (min)", typing "Bottle" in the field labelled "Notes", and clicking the button "Add activity" adds a list item containing "Feeding", "2h 0m", and "Bottle"; the text "No activities yet" is removed.
Selecting "Sleep" in the field labelled "Type", typing "45" in the field labelled "Duration (min)", and clicking the button "Add activity" adds a list item containing "Sleep" and "45m".
Selecting "Diaper" in the field labelled "Type", clicking the button "Add activity" without entering a duration adds a list item containing "Diaper" and "—".
Clicking the button labelled "Feeding" in the filter bar shows only the list item containing "Feeding" and "2h 0m"; the items containing "Sleep" and "Diaper" are hidden.
Clicking the button labelled "All" in the filter bar shows all three list items: one containing "Feeding", one containing "Sleep", and one containing "Diaper".
Clicking the button "Delete Feeding" on the list item containing "Feeding" removes that item; the list now shows only the items containing "Sleep" and "Diaper".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose first line is "type,timestamp,duration,notes" and whose second line contains "Feeding" and "Bottle".
Reload keeps the list item containing "Sleep" and "45m" after the page is reloaded.
